newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Metway merger to take 3 yrs-chairman.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Metway merger to take 3 yrs-chairman.

text.p: The merger of Metway Bank Ltd, Suncorp and Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC) will take up to three years to be completed, chairman of the merged group, John Lamble said.
Asked how long the merger would take to complete, Lamble said: "our target is two (years) but I don't think it will be finished by three (years)."
Lamble told a Morgan Stockbroking breakfast meeting that the name of the new group was to be Suncorp-Metway group and would start up on December 1.
"The general plan is to become known as Suncorp-Metway," Lamble said.
Lamble also said the new bank board had interviewed a number of candidates for the post of chief executive.
"We have interviewed a number of candidates. Two are being considered and a third has not been seen yet.
"For the first month or so we won't particularly miss a chief executive for that time. But the board recognises it is a matter of urgency," Lamble said.
Details of the merger proposal under which Metway would acquire the Queensland State government-owned QIDC and Suncorp, are expected to be released later on Wednesday.
Current Metway shareholders would be offered the option to remain shareholders of the new group or sell their shareholding for A$4.80 cash.
The merger would create Queensland's biggest public company and Australia's fifth-largest listed financial services group.
